dct_description_sm:
This is a collection that contains code and dataframes of a study that investigates the well-being trend of Afghanistan population following the U.S. military withdrawal in 2021. 

The synthetic analytic datasets in this data collection are provided solely for study replication and should not be used for other purposes.
dct_title_s: Code and Replication Data for Afghanistan Well-being
